svg.aria-label: The Road Network Integration Toolkit dialog as it appears when first opened, with empty inputs, defaults selected and an empty log

g.text: Integrate complementary road networks using a guided workflow
Use Browse to choose a vector file or a layer inside a GeoPackage (.gpkg) or File Geodatabase (.gdb). Only layers with the
expected geometry type (lines for roads, polygons for the boundary) are offered.
Choose this the same way you select a CRS in QGIS export or reprojection tools. A projected CRS with metre units is required
for distance-based processing. When you pick a study-area boundary, a suitable UTM zone is suggested automatically unless you
have already chosen a CRS yourself.
The displayed values are the workflow defaults, in metres. Tick Advanced settings to edit them; unticking restores the defaults.
These values are passed to the legacy-compatible processing engine for buffer, trimming, and snapping operations.
Select the mandatory output / working folder...
Enter a project or city code, e.g. KE_Nairobi
Enter an output name to preview the final filename.
Automatically add successful outputs to the QGIS project
Ready. Select your inputs and run a methodology.
Validation and processing messages will appear here.
